item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 07:10 AM 25 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #DinagatIslands(Cagdianao, Basilisa, SanJose, Dinagat), #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, SanFrancisco, SiargaoIsland, Socorro), #SurigaoDelSur(Carrascal, Carmen, Cantilan, Madrid, CityOfBislig, Lingig), #DavaoOriental(Caraga, Boston, Cateel, Baganga), #ZamboangaCity, #ZamboangaDelNorte(DipologCity, Polanco, Piñan, DapitanCity and LaLibertad) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(Claver, Gigaquit), #DinagatIslands(Libjo, Tubajon, Loreto), #SurigaoDelSur(Lanuza, Cortes and Hinatuan) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
